title: Missing load (field) supply on an I/O module
summary: The PLC commands outputs but nothing switches; the module reports missing supply voltage.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: The PLC commands outputs but nothing switches; the module reports missing supply voltage.

troubleshooting.target: Load voltage of a digital output module
troubleshooting.effect: Outputs stay off although the program sets them
symptoms: Output tags TRUE, output LEDs off, actuators idle
evidence: Voltage at the module's supply terminals
diagnosticMethod: Confirm the output is commanded in the PLC
Measure the load supply and the fuse
repair: Restore the load supply (fuse, wiring, power supply)
troubleshooting.explanation: Output modules switch the field supply to the load; without it the electronics work but no current can flow to the actuators.
